scope: Blind machine recognition of final decoded audio, waveform alignment, container decode, and local Chrome transport. No microphone or physical room/speaker test.

asr_method.source: Final MP4 AAC decoded with FFmpeg 8.1.1 to 16,000 Hz mono float PCM. Both ASR passes consume this same mix.
passes: Contiguous full track, transcribed before opening the SRT.
Independently decode each SRT time window with 160 ms leading and trailing padding; only time boundaries enter inference.
asr_method.scoring: Levenshtein distance over case-insensitive words, excluding speaker labels and punctuation. Preserve contractions and distinct clock readings. Treat one/1, forty/40, 8am/8 AM, a.m./AM, B-roll/b-roll as equivalent. Capitalization and sentence punctuation are preserved in the raw transcripts.

acoustics_method.audio_stats: 48,000 Hz float decode for full-scale samples and contiguous 10 ms RMS windows below the listed thresholds. FFmpeg loudnorm input stats for integrated LUFS, LRA and oversampled true peak.
acoustics_method.sync: At each SRT cue, select the loudest 400 ms of the dialogue stem and match its first-differenced waveform against final AAC within 500 ms of the expected location. V2 cue 8 uses the separately encoded board at its recorded join time. Match resolution is one sample at 16 kHz. Stem onsets and releases are the first and last 10 ms RMS windows above -45 dBFS within the indicated interval plus 40 ms each side.
acoustics_method.limits: One waveform anchor per cue; speech onsets/releases are threshold estimates. These are compatible with inaudible consonant tails and ordinary synthetic-voice padding.

browser_method.host: macOS 27.2.1, local Google Chrome 157.0.8103.79, headless isolated contexts.
browser_method.conditions: Cache disabled. HTTP transports throttled to 400000 download bytes/s and 5 ms latency to keep requested frames uncached. A first out-of-buffer seek, then reverse and forward seeks. No bandwidth throttle on direct file playback.
browser_method.decode: Read metadata, wait for seeked, play the unmuted media element, measure elapsed media time and decoded video frames. HTTP Web Audio analyser measures maximum sample-window RMS over at least 720 ms playback before a zero-gain sink. A null RMS on HTTP means the sampled window was digitally silent; no meter was attached to file URLs.
browser_method.stock_range_server: System Ruby 2.6.10, WEBrick 1.9.1. An ephemeral port was used for Chrome comparisons and port 8765 for the exact rehearsal command/full-byte downloads.
